central_rule: All predictive inputs must be available at or before cutoff, strictly before target-game kickoff. Target and observed participation are never predictive inputs.
population: Retrospectively observed kicker participation; conditional on participation, not an automatic starter prediction. Training eligibility remains unapproved.
history_scope: Same-season prior available games; rolling windows require 3 games. No implicit filling across seasons.
